products.body_html: 160L Large Dual Chamber Capacity Design Dual separate chambers let you start new compost while one batch is fermenting, greatly improving composting efficiency; 160L large volume handles yard leaves, grass clippings, fruit & vegetable kitchen scraps easily. Easy Rotating Tumbler Structure The octagonal barrel can be smoothly rotated manually without digging or turning waste by hand. Internal mixing ribs fully stir organic materials to speed up aerobic decomposition and shorten composting cycle. Two Wide Access Doors for Convenient Feeding & Harvesting Two large sealed latch doors allow you to add raw materials and take out finished fertilizer effortlessly; tight seal effectively locks heat and moisture, prevents pest invasion and odor leakage. Stable Rust-Proof Heavy-Duty Metal Frame High-strength coated steel stand keeps the compost barrel elevated off damp ground to avoid rot; anti-rust coating adapts to all weather conditions for year-round outdoor use. UV-Resistant Food-Grade Thick PP Material Thickened UV-stabilized polypropylene prevents cracking, fading and aging under long-term sun exposure; perfect for backyard, garden, farm and courtyard organic gardening use.
